content.text:
No. Sarah Chen cannot approve DR-9109. The request relies on Acme contract pricing that does not cover NS-EDGE, and 12% is above her own authority in any case. The outcome is **REVIEW_REQUIRED**.

**1. The request.** DR-9109 asks for 12% off NS-EDGE. The list value is $85,000, the discount $10,200 and the net $74,800. Sarah Chen requested it on 2026-09-23, and it is Pending Approval. The stated basis is "Contract pricing per Acme Master Supply Agreement", which is a contract or exception basis.

**2. The customer.** CRM-2048 "Acme Manufacturing" and ERP C-1001 "Acme Mfg. Holdings" are the same customer. The DUNS number (04-812-7730) and the address both match, and the agreement names Acme Mfg. Holdings doing business as Acme Manufacturing.

**3. The product.** NS-EDGE is the NS-Edge Monitoring Package, with a list price of $85,000. The 12% figure is consistent with list.

**4. Active contract.** ACME-MFG-2025 is in force from 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31, so it was active on 2026-09-23. It lists NS-EDGE as a supplied product. However, its only discount term (§3.2) gives up to 15% on **NS-500 only**. §3.3 says contractual eligibility does not change internal approval authority.

**5. Pricing exception.** EXC-ACME-NS500-15 covers NS-500 only. It states that it "does not apply to any other Northstar product." The older EXC-ACME-NS500-10 is also NS-500 only and expired on 2025-03-31. No registered exception or amendment covers NS-EDGE. The contract pricing the request cites therefore does not exist for this product.

**6. Policy.** PRICING-POLICY-2026 was in force on 2026-09-23. The 2026 Approval Authority Matrix uses the same bands.

**7. Requestor authority.** Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive, so her limit is 10% or less. 12% is above that.

**8. Required approver.** Discounts above 10% and up to 20% need VP Sales approval, which is Michael Torres (EMP-200). Discounts above 10% also need recorded approval evidence in Northstar CRM.

**9. Decision.** The special terms the request relies on do not extend to NS-EDGE, so the request needs commercial review. It can be approved neither on the contract basis nor by Sarah Chen. If it is resubmitted as a standard-pricing discount, 12% would still need Michael Torres's approval, recorded in CRM.

  "outcome": "REVIEW_REQUIRED",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9109", "customer": "Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048) / Acme Mfg. Holdings (ERP C-1001)", "product": "NS-EDGE", "requested_discount": 12.0,
              "date": "2026-09-23", "requestor": "Sarah Chen (sarah.chen@northstar.example)", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "not_covered",
                             "maximum_discount": null, "basis": "ACME-MFG-2025 §3.2 and EXC-ACME-NS500-15 grant discount eligibility on NS-500 only; no registered exception or amendment covers NS-EDGE"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2026", "requestor_limit": 10, "requestor_authorized": false,
                "required_role": "VP Sales", "approver": "Michael Torres"},
  "evidence": [
    "structured/discount_requests.csv: DR-9109, NS-EDGE, 12.0%, 2026-09-23, justification 'Contract pricing per Acme Master Supply Agreement', Pending Approval",
    "crm_accounts.csv CRM-2048 and customers.csv C-1001 match on DUNS 04-812-7730 and address",
    "products.csv: NS-EDGE list price 85000 USD",
    "ACME-MFG-2025 (in force 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31): §3.2 discount eligibility up to 15% on NS-500 only; §3.3 no change to approval authority",
    "EXC-ACME-NS500-15: NS-500 only, max 15%, does not apply to any other product",
    "EXC-ACME-NS500-10: NS-500 only, expired 2025-03-31",
    "OWM register: no amendments to customer agreements",
    "PRICING-POLICY-2026 and APP-MATRIX-2026: EAE <=10%, VP Sales >10% to 20%, CRO >20%; >10% requires recorded approval evidence in CRM",
    "employees.csv: Sarah Chen, Enterprise Account Executive; Michael Torres, VP Sales"
  ],
  "missing_evidence": [],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Commercial review of whether any discount on NS-EDGE is justified, since no Acme contract term or pricing exception covers NS-EDGE; the request's 'contract pricing' justification must be corrected or new terms established", "who": "Deal Desk / Michael Torres (VP Sales)", "blocking": true},
    {"what": "Any 12% discount (>10%) requires VP Sales approval by Michael Torres, recorded in Northstar CRM; Sarah Chen cannot self-approve", "who": "Michael Torres (VP Sales)", "blocking": true}
  ]
}
